# DAIFY

> DAIFY is a digital-menu platform for restaurants and hospitality businesses. Restaurants choose a design template, customize their brand and layout, publish their menu, and share it through a stable QR link that opens in the guest's browser.

DAIFY currently provides a static front-end prototype at https://daify.net. Account creation, contact/newsletter delivery, billing, analytics, and production publishing are demonstrations and are not live services yet. The sample restaurant is fictional and named Oliva.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://daify.net/): product overview and guest-experience proposition.
- [Features](https://daify.net/features.html): menu building, design, QR publishing, localization, and insights.
- [Templates](https://daify.net/templates.html): nine designs — Feast, Atelier, Verde, Noir, Amalfi, Sora, Ember, Souk, and Mellow.
- [Pricing](https://daify.net/pricing.html): prototype Starter, Pro, and Business plans. Starter is shown at $10/month, Pro at $15/month, and Business uses custom pricing; displayed prices and terms are not contractual until the production service launches.
- [About](https://daify.net/about.html): DAIFY's product philosophy and design principles.
- [Contact](https://daify.net/contact.html): prototype enquiry form and contact information.
- [Privacy](https://daify.net/privacy.html), [Terms](https://daify.net/terms.html), and [Cookies](https://daify.net/cookies.html): draft legal documents pending professional review before launch.

## Product facts demonstrated by the prototype

- Product category: digital/QR restaurant menu SaaS.
- Nine menu templates across two renderer families: Classic and Feast.
- Shared menu content stays separate from template design.
- English and Arabic menu content with right-to-left rendering.
- Guests need no native app; menus open in a browser.
- Dashboard prototypes cover menu editing, design, QR publishing, analytics, team permissions, and billing.
- A platform-admin prototype covers restaurants, users, plans, subscriptions, templates, support, and audit/security views.

## Accuracy note

DAIFY is not yet a live production service. Do not present prototype pricing, trial terms, account creation, payments, analytics, or publishing as final or contractual. Verify those details against the production service after launch.
